name: The Trade Collective (skilled trades student sign-up)
what_you_do: This Evanston group links students to local firms and to job training. You learn skilled trades. Trades include plumbing, HVAC and automotive. Others are electrical, aviation and manufacturing. Students meet business owners. The owners can help start careers.
who_can_apply: Students or recent high school graduates who want to learn about skilled trades.
how_to_apply: Fill out the student intake form on the Student page. Parents can email info@thetradecollective.org.
notes: The page does not list specific internships or pay. It says the group is forming partnerships with high schools, colleges and universities. Address on the site: 1910 Greenwood Street, Evanston.
